title: Preserve safe per-channel content generation in Anthropic deadline regression
root_cause: Inherited tests/brain-anthropic-subcall-deadline-p0-4198.test.mjs asserts removed MAX_CHANNEL_GENERATIONS and bootstrapAttempted symbols. Current canonical powerhouse-content-loop/index.ts uses a bounded per-channel Promise.all on only publish/decided channels, suppressing second dispatch after unknown/in-flight bootstrap, within the same supervisor.
impact: One independently observed failure in Unified BRAIN 39791707071 on exact 8e665a86d2bb54712a34fd88bec0e1213df21dd2. Blindly reverting to a global single-generation cap would strand other authorized channels.
fix: Replace obsolete identifier checks with source-based assertions for canonical pending decisions, per-channel targeted generation, in-flight bootstrap gate and provider-ack/possible-side-effect protection. Preserve 90-second Anthropic and 110-second supervisor deadlines, social identity and bounded output assertions. No runtime, dispatch or provider changes.
prevention_rule: Test actual current supervisor source and behavior; when generation topology changes, update its source oracle in the same bounded change. Never resurrect obsolete per-tick caps or mask duplicate publication or unknown provider side effects to turn CI green.
outcome: CANDIDATE: exact-head CI, CodeQL, full Unified BRAIN, registry writeback and production readback not yet proven
